scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.training:validate: python3 training/build_public_bootstrap_dataset.py --self-test && python3 -m py_compile training/build_public_bootstrap_dataset.py training/build_public_bootstrap_iteration2.py training/build_public_bootstrap_iteration3.py training/build_public_bootstrap_iteration4.py training/build_public_bootstrap_iteration5.py training/validate_notebook.py && python3 training/validate_notebook.py
